title: Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Association (SCAORA) v. Union of India (Second Judges Case)

content.caseIdentity: Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Association (SCAORA) v. Union of India (Second Judges Case), (1993) 4 SCC 441
content.holding: Judicial independence is a basic feature of the Constitution; "consultation" under Articles 124(2) and 217(1) means "concurrence", establishing the primacy of the CJI and senior puisne judges in appointments.
